Dear Sir, 
 
With reference to the above referred Regulation and in continuation of our letter dated 
9th October, 2026 regarding schedule of Earnings Conference Call, please find below 
the link of the audio recording of the said Earnings Conference Call for Q2 for the 
Financial Year 2026-27. The same is available on the website of the Company at 
https://www.elecon.com/investors/audio-video-recordings-and-transcripts-of-
post-earnings-quarterly-calls.  
 
You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Elecon Engineering Company Limited, 
 
 
 
Bharti Isarani
